evidence: Static security review found no live credential, real-person identifier, author-machine path, authored unpinned remote script fetch or instruction-injection payload in the frozen task. task/task.toml:34 retains ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}" and line 35 is empty; instruction.md:13 explicitly calls the accounts demo accounts, seed_data.json:44/51/58/65/72/79/86 uses hireops.example, and solution/app/src/db.js:126 labels Hireops!2026 the public demo credential. Both complete seed JSON copies are byte-identical, contain no secret/password/token field, and have ordinary roster/economic strings rather than instructions. The only email domains across all 37 shipped files are hireops.example and local.invalid. Container paths (/app, /assets, /tests, /root/.codex) are the documented runtime/template paths, not author-host contamination. App requests are its own observed/local API (solution/app/public/js/app.js:38-45), and bootstrap.js:28-30 proxies only to 127.0.0.1. Dependency installs are versioned npm/pip in template-identical Dockerfiles; apt is the explicit workbook Note-only exception. Public browser CDN permission in instruction.md:9 and integration.md:12-14 is allowed by the current profile. The bounded scanner exercised four synthetic broken controls and four conforming controls without mutating or executing the candidate. source-audit.json SHA256 767dd442b650fc5b33b9e14ab5931bdc12f0d3cb58c733449ece0a1bfbdd22cc records zero pattern hits, no frozen task/rules hash drift, and all 445 raw-index artifact hashes matching at audit time (index SHA256 f1266aafb735e7f790c355938710c6432a48a2f2a00af69966438cee77c128ab). This is a manual/source audit with local scanner observations, not a private deterministic-checker run, Docker/image run, configured judge run or hosted score. Row 52 does not require those unrelated score measurements; no row-specific unresolved defect or required missing measurement remains.
counterexample: Plausible broken alternatives were assessed locally: an otherwise functional app with a provider-key-shaped literal in its solution, an author home path in notes, a seed instruction to ignore previous instructions/award credit, or a verifier curl-to-shell command. The synthetic scanner controls flag each. A conforming demo password, ${OPENROUTER_API_KEY} template, documented container paths and public browser CDN reference trigger none. Manual context review applies the workbook/skill exceptions rather than treating every credential-looking or remote-looking string as a failure; no end-to-end grade is inferred from these controls.
